members.name: at
members.doc: The one at this place: at(0) is the first, at(-1) the last.

members.name: every
members.doc: Whether a test is true for all: every(m => !m.user.bot).

members.name: filter
members.doc: Only those a test picks: filter(m => !m.user.bot).

members.name: find
members.doc: The first one a test picks: find(m => m.displayName === "Ada").

members.name: first
members.doc: The first one (first(3): the first three, as a list).

members.name: firstKey
members.doc: The first one's key (its id).

members.name: get
members.doc: The one with this key (an id): get("123456789012345678").

members.name: has
members.doc: Whether it holds one with this key (an id): has("123…").

members.name: last
members.doc: The last one.

members.name: lastKey
members.doc: The last one's key (its id).

members.name: map
members.doc: Something from each, as a list: map(m => m.displayName).

members.name: random
members.doc: One picked at random.

members.name: size
members.doc: How many it holds.

members.name: some
members.doc: Whether a test is true for any: some(m => m.user.bot).

members.name: sort
members.doc: Sorted by a comparison: sort((a, b) => a.joinedTimestamp - b.joinedTimestamp).

members.name: get
members.doc: The one with this key: get("key").

members.name: has
members.doc: Whether it holds one with this key.

members.name: keys
members.doc: Its keys, one after another ([...x.keys()] for a list).

members.name: size
members.doc: How many it holds.

members.name: values
members.doc: What it holds, one after another ([...x.values()] for a list).
